introduction: Explore the Surface Realm: seventeen independent story outcomes and six support rows, including regional deliveries, competing trophies and the labyrinth's exact five-material finale. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The Surface Realm is one large discovered zone covering many continental regions. Use nearby contacts and the exact zone journal command to follow encountered requests. Discovery supplies regional guidance; it does not reveal every contact or require exploring every grid room.

Most stories are independent deliveries. Native exchanges accept exact materials supplied by another player. Current possession, personal source recovery and durable accepted delivery are separate facts; inspecting this journal grants no history or keyword achievement.

The labyrinth campaign has competing offerings: four different warden trophies buy a book, while each warden asks for a separate labyrinthmaster heart to buy one elemental locket. A single heart cannot serve four consumers, and killing a warden can remove that appearance as a locket recipient.

The mystic's finale requires the book plus fire, water, earth and air lockets together. These are five current item kinds, not five earlier receipts. The air locket has copied fire keywords; the actual object kind distinguishes it. Earlier personal campaign receipts are optional rather than enforced.

The ornate gemmed reward key opens the downwards tomb door in the forest beyond the surface approach. The neighboring transparent gateway has another key and a different continuation. Local hand-in credit does not establish later access or foreign quest completion.

Opposing raider bounties and elemental prophet requests remain separate stories. Their pledge or victory prose supplies a role-playing choice without durable allegiance, permanent world defeat or mutually exclusive branch enforcement.

The tundra hunter has a five-fang equipment service and a paw story. Complete desired necklace work before the paw exchange retires that appearance. The rewarded white potion can serve a separate nomad request; a supplied potion qualifies without the producer's earlier receipt.

Five nightcrawler claws, a witchdoctor totem, three blood crystals and two independent wyvern-egg requests use exact current materials. Kills, worn items and earlier deliveries cannot replace those supplies. One egg is consumed by one recipient; narrated study or rebirth has no extra recorded endpoint.

Three fishing-market rows group independent support barters without quest achievements or dailies. Breale bass and normal large bass are distinct kinds. A valid supplied fish satisfies a barter without manufacturing a first personal catch.

The gland/bracer and four-crystal wand recipes also require coins. Their mixed settlement remains guarded while accounting is active. Preparation hints do not prove wallet readiness. The bracer has no ordinary loaded repeatable source found in this review.

Private dispersal hubs, capped proof, roaming contacts and 99-percent campaign appearances need actual availability qualification. A starting room or reset declaration is a lead; do not promise that a quest recipient or every material is currently present.

Treant death creates wood, the highwayman guardian can summon help, and the shadow rift chooses its destination by racewar context. Accepted source, helper and confirmed-travel events are needed before these mechanics can become recorded stages. The old devil death invasion is commented out.

Ports, travel buildings and class teachers have separate service and travel mechanics. Epic purchases remain unavailable while accounting is active. The old descend continuation is disabled; possession of campaign rewards does not make it a playable quest.

Directional boundary access and foreign source or continuation receipts retain their own area ownership. Two surface exits reference an unloaded room and have a targeted repair plan; neither discovery nor receipt tests certify a played access journey.

stories.summary: Bring four different warden trophies together to the labyrinthmaster for a book, one thousand platinum and a declared one million XP. This offering competes with the wardens' reverse requests; it records an accepted delivery without proving four personal kills or a lasting campaign victory.

steps.hint: The philosopher carries this exact heart, with cap one. It is distinct from the stargazer and enchanter hearts.

stories.title: The mystic's five offerings
stories.summary: Bring the book and four distinct elemental lockets together to the powerful mystic. The accepted exchange grants a sash and an ornate key. These are five current materials, without an enforced earlier sequence or proof of reading every rune.

steps.text: Carry the crumbling locket of fire
steps.hint: The enchanter rewards the fire locket. It is one of four different locket kinds; supplied exact lockets are accepted.

steps.text: Carry the crumbling locket of water
steps.hint: The traveler rewards the water locket. An earlier branch receipt does not replace the currently carried locket.

steps.text: Carry the crumbling locket of earth
steps.hint: The philosopher rewards the earth locket. Keep it separate from the three other elemental kinds.

steps.text: Carry the crumbling locket of air
steps.hint: The stargazer rewards the air locket. Its copied keywords say fire, but its exact kind and display name identify air. Four fire lockets cannot replace this collection.

steps.text: Carry the mystical book of tommorrows
steps.hint: The labyrinthmaster rewards this book for the four different warden trophies. A supplied book is valid without requiring the bearer's own earlier campaign receipt.

The mystic starts at the small temple. Acceptance grants the sash of sorcerous power and ornate gemmed key, then retires the mystic. The key opens the downwards tomb door in the forest beyond the nearby surface approach; the separate transparent gateway uses a different key and is not this reward's access route.

steps.hint: The rival raider carries his head, with cap one, starting at "A Thick Forest of Tanglewood". Supplied proof qualifies without a personally recorded kill.
Krekish starts at "Overgrown Grasslands of the Northern Wilds". Acceptance grants bracer, 10,000 copper and declared 40,000 XP, then retires this appearance.

stories.title: Gr'Tak's rival trophy
stories.summary: Bring Krekish's head to Gr'Tak for a chain bracelet, fifteen platinum and declared ninety thousand XP. Both opposing deliveries can have independent receipts; the native contracts enforce no lasting allegiance.

steps.hint: Krekish carries his head, with cap one, starting at "Overgrown Grasslands of the Northern Wilds". It is different from the raider head used by the opposing request.
Gr'Tak starts at "A Thick Forest of Tanglewood". Acceptance grants bracelet, 15,000 copper and declared 90,000 XP, then retires this appearance.

stories.title: The Mountaineer's five claws
stories.summary: Bring five actual nightcrawler claws together for the Mountaineers' insignia and declared 105,000 XP. Membership praise is narrative; no persistent guild membership or personal-kill predicate is created.

steps.hint: Nine equipped claws share cap nine across fourteen nightcrawler appearances at the two local dispersal hubs. Five appearances have no claw equipment declaration. Remove five actual claws into top-level carrying; five kills or worn claws do not replace them.
The Mountaineer starts at "Rugged Hills of the Hearth Valley" and can roam. Acceptance grants insignia and declared 105,000 XP; he remains available.

stories.title: The watchman's witchdoctor totem
stories.summary: Deliver the lizardman witchdoctor's totem for fifty platinum. The accepted proof does not establish a personal raid, leader kill or permanent regional victory.

steps.hint: Five lizardman witchdoctor equipment declarations share cap five in the private dispersal hub. The actual witchdoctor totem is required; an arbitrary lizardman head cannot substitute.
The watchman starts at "Along a Gravel Highway" and can roam. Acceptance pays 50,000 copper and leaves him present.

stories.title: The hunter's lost brother
stories.summary: Bring the grey panther's paw to the hunter for a white potion and declared ninety thousand XP. The potion can then be delivered to a separate nomad, but that onward request is independently owned and accepts supplied potions.

steps.text: Carry the bloody paw of Grey Fang
steps.hint: The grey panther carries this paw, with cap one, at "Snow Capped Hills of the Tundra". Exact supplied proof qualifies. Complete any desired fang-necklace work before this exchange retires the current hunter appearance.
The hunter starts at "A Small Camp Site". Acceptance grants white potion and declared 90,000 XP, then retires him. It does not record personal revenge or completing the necklace service.

stories.title: The nomad's white potion
stories.summary: Deliver the white potion to the nomad for three hundred platinum and declared fifty thousand XP. The hunter's reward provides a suggested route; it is not a compulsory history step.

steps.hint: The tundra hunter rewards this exact potion for the grey paw; a rare Alatorin equipment declaration is another source. A supplied potion is accepted without requiring the bearer's earlier hunter receipt.

The nomad starts at "The Amber Sands of an Island Desert" and can roam. Acceptance pays 300,000 copper and declared 50,000 XP, then retires this appearance. Possessing the potion records neither delivery.

stories.title: The wizard's three blood crystals
stories.summary: Bring three blood crystals together for two hundred platinum and declared 115,000 XP. This independent offering competes with the paid four-crystal wand recipe.

steps.hint: Twenty-four ordinary ground declarations on the Isle of Death share cap twenty-four. The wizard consumes three crystals; the wand service consumes four different currently carried crystals and a fee. An earlier hand-in cannot supply either later recipe.
The wizard starts at "The Rugged Foothills of Cyric the Destroyer". Acceptance pays 200,000 copper and declared 115,000 XP, then retires him.

stories.title: The seer's wyvern study
stories.summary: Bring a wyvern egg to the centaur seer for ninety-five platinum and declared sixty-five thousand XP. This study is separate from the demi-lich's same-kind request; no hatch, protection or study-completion state is recorded.

steps.hint: Two surface ground egg declarations at "The Rugged Foothills of Cyric the Destroyer" and "The Rugged Foothills of Cyric the Destroyer" share cap two; foreign vehicle and Alatorin placements also exist. Each recipient consumes one actual egg. One egg or an earlier receipt cannot prepare both requests.
The seer starts at "A High Egress Along the Sylvan Bluffs". Acceptance pays 95,000 copper and declared 65,000 XP, then retires him.

stories.summary: Bring a wyvern egg to the demi-lich for ninety-five platinum and declared ninety-five thousand XP. Rebirth prose accompanies acceptance, while no transformed wyvern actor or world rebirth event is implemented.

steps.hint: Two surface ground egg declarations at "The Rugged Foothills of Cyric the Destroyer" and "The Rugged Foothills of Cyric the Destroyer" share cap two; foreign vehicle and Alatorin placements also exist. The demi-lich starts at "Rocky Foothills of the Black Mountains" and can roam. Acceptance pays 95,000 copper and declared 95,000 XP, then retires this appearance.

steps.text: Carry The head of the Prophet of Ice
steps.hint: The Ice prophet carries this exact head, with cap one. Delivering it here is distinct from the opposing Fire-head request. A supplied head does not prove personal combat.

The Fire prophet starts at "An Altar of Fire" and remains after acceptance. The native request mistakenly introduces him as Ice; the actual prototype and rewards identify Fire. Acceptance grants ring and three potions.

stories.summary: Bring the Fire prophet's head to the Ice prophet for a frosty ring and three icy-cold potions. Opposing receipts are independent; the native contracts enforce no mutually exclusive allegiance.

steps.text: Carry the head of the Prophet of Fire
steps.hint: The Fire prophet carries this exact head, with cap one. It is different from the Ice head requested by the opposing prophet.
The Ice prophet starts at "An Altar of Ice" and remains after acceptance. Acceptance grants ring and three potions; describing a pledge does not establish a recorded faction choice.

steps.hint: Carry one exact listed fish or shellfish. Most ordinary kinds have fishing or other sources; the Breale bass is a different kind from the normal large bass. Supplied stock is valid without manufacturing a first personal catch.
